sv.title: Dagens rekar: Telia köpstämplas
sv.summary: Bland dagens aktierekommendationer märks en ny köprekommendation för folkaktien Telia, samtidigt som flera riktkurser justeras upp för Asmodee, som rapporterade i fredags.

en.title: Today's ratings: Telia upgraded to buy
en.summary: Among today's share recommendations is a new buy rating for the popular stock Telia, while several price targets are raised for Asmodee, which reported on Friday.
